dummy_grid_rule_check.prime_ordering: Only one dummy in each gap on the x-axis (1' between grid 1 and grid 2; 2' beyond grid 2) — no multi-dummy gap on this house, so the prime-ordering scan rule was not needed.
dummy_grid_rule_check.negative_pos_m: Not applicable — no dummy grid falls before the origin on this house (unlike house #04/#05); the S-04 west/east overhang figures were read as eave overhang, not beam endpoints, so no negative-pos_m dummy was created for them (see warnings).
